info.title: Fleet Manager API
info.description: The public Fleet Manager control API. Mutations return durable operations; the controller-node channel is a separate, separately versioned protocol.

get.summary:
The live event stream of one operation: a fresh snapshot whenever the
operation changes.
get.description:
Reconnect protocol: the client sends `Last-Event-ID` with the last
snapshot's `updated_at`. Because snapshots are not archived, any change
since that cursor is announced as a `gap` event, and the client refetches
the operation before trusting the stream again. A terminal operation emits
its final snapshot and closes the stream.

# Errors

Returns the public error envelope when the caller may not read the
operation or it does not exist.

200.description: A text/event-stream of operation snapshots, with `gap` markers after missed changes.

403.description: The caller may not read operations.

Records discovered checkouts as this project's observed facts. Checkouts

Registers an account and stores its token secret. The account starts

post.summary:
Records one guest's facts onto a confirmed Fleet machine. The machine
funnel authorizes and audits the capability write.
post.description:

403.description: The caller may not read the Proxmox surface or write the machine's facts.

409.description: The account's trust is unconfirmed or the host fingerprint was refused.

Imports a tailnet device as an SSH onboarding draft: the draft carries
the device's Tailscale IPv4 address; everything after is the standard
staged flow (test, explicit fingerprint confirm, review, add).

backend failure.

AddedMachineDto.description:
The outcome of an add: the new machine plus the duplicates that were
warned about.

duplicates.description:
Existing machines that shared the draft's host and port. The add
proceeded anyway: candidates warn, they do not merge.

machine.description: The registered machine, redacted per the caller's permissions.

ApiError.description:
The body of every unsuccessful response.

It is built from [`PublicError`], which is the type that decides what is
safe to disclose. Internal causes, provider output, and secret values are
excluded there rather than filtered here.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, not on `message`.

correlationId.description:
The correlation identity of the request that failed. It is also returned
in the `x-correlation-id` response header, and is what an operator needs
to find the request in the audit trail.

fieldViolations.description: Per-field rejections, when the failure is a validation failure.

retry.description: Retry guidance for this specific failure.

ApplyActionDto.description: One planned action the caller submits.

actionOrder.description: The action's order the approval covers.

kind.description: The action's operation kind the approval covers.

planId.description: The plan's identity the approval is bound to.

oneOf.description: The controller's agent supplies the key.
A specific identity file.

ApplyAuthDto.description: How the apply workflow's endpoint authenticates.

AssociatedGuestDto.description: One discovered guest with its Fleet-machine association candidates.

oneOf.description: The guest-agent view, when the guest has one.

candidates.description: The Fleet machines this guest may be — evidence, never merged.

pveVersion.description: The PVE version the observation came from.

status.description: The PVE status string, when carried.

AssociationCandidateDto.description: One Fleet machine a guest may be, with the evidence.

machineId.description: The existing machine's identity.

CapabilityFactDto.description:
One capability fact as the read model displays it: the recorded status
with the staleness rule applied at the read time.

name.description: The capability name within the namespace, e.g. `git`, `family`.

observedAt.description: When the fact was observed (epoch milliseconds).

source.description: What observed it: a probe name and version, e.g. `agentless/1`.

status.description:
The effective status: `known`, `stale`, `unknown`, or `unavailable`.
`stale` means the fact was once known but nothing re-observed it
within the freshness threshold; `unknown` means no probe ever
answered for it; they are deliberately different states.

value.description: The observed value, when the capability has one.

oneOf.description: The controller's agent supplies the key.
A specific identity file.

CheckoutAuthDto.description: How a checkout action's endpoint authenticates.

CheckoutFactDto.description: One observed checkout of a project.

dirty.description: Whether the worktree was dirty at observation.

machineId.description: The machine carrying the checkout.

ConfigureTailnetRequest.description:
The configure request: the OAuth client's id and secret. The secret is
stored encrypted and never returned by any endpoint.

ConfirmHostKeyRequest.description: The body of the confirm-host-key request.

fingerprint.description:
The OpenSSH `SHA256:` fingerprint being confirmed. It must match the
fingerprint the host presented.

ConfirmProxmoxFingerprintRequest.description: The confirm-trust request: the fingerprint the caller observed.

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint as observed (colons optional).

connectedToControl.description: Whether the device recently connected to control.

lastSeen.description: When the device was last seen, when carried.

online.description: Whether the device reports itself online.

CorrelationCandidateDto.description: One Fleet machine a tailnet device may be.

machineId.description: The existing machine's identity.

ttlMillis.description:
The token's lifetime in milliseconds, between one minute and one day.
Absent means one hour.

CreateOnboardingDraftRequest.description: The body of the create-draft request.

description.description: Operator notes carried onto the machine.

name.description: The proposed machine name; derived from the host when omitted.

CreateOperationRequest.description: The body of the create-operation request.

deadlineAt.description:
The absolute deadline, in Unix epoch milliseconds, after which the
operation must be treated as timed out. Absent means no deadline.

idempotencyKey.description:
A caller-chosen key making this request idempotent: replaying it
returns the original operation instead of creating a second one.

kind.description:
The kind of work to create; only kinds the controller can describe are
accepted.

payloadJson.description:
The bounded provider input for kinds that need one, e.g. the script

tags.name: system
tags.description: The controller's own view of itself.

tags.name: machines
tags.description: The operational machine view: identity, endpoints, capability facts, connectivity state, and the last observation. Endpoint references are redacted unless the caller may read sensitive endpoint detail.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Projects keyed by normalized Git remote, with per-machine observed checkouts. The remote is the identity; checkouts are facts.

tags.name: tailnet
tags.description: Optional Tailscale discovery: correlated tailnet devices and the import handoff into the onboarding flow. Correlation is evidence only; Fleet identity never derives from Tailscale.

tags.name: proxmox
tags.description: Proxmox accounts, TLS fingerprint trust, and cluster discovery. The token secret is write-only; discovery is locked until the host fingerprint is confirmed.

tags.name: nodes
tags.description: Node enrollment and identity: enrollment tokens, node state, and revocation. The machine-facing enrollment endpoints under /api/node/v1 are versioned with the node protocol and documented in proto/README.md, not here.
